input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The agreement has no insurance covenant of any kind: searches for "insurance", "insure/coverage/policy", "liability" and "indemnif" return no responsive clause, and a full read of Sections 1-10 (including the General Provisions in Section 10, which end at 10.8 Headings; Counterparts, p0070) shows no requirement for HDI to carry any coverage. The rule applies because HDI designs, hosts and operates the Site on its own server, provides order export/import processing, and under Section 8.1 has access to Company "Content, user information, data" - i.e. it processes our data. A hosting vendor that processes personal data with no insurance is walk-away territory, so this fails even the fallback (E&O $1M / cyber $2M). We therefore insert a single short Section 10.9 at the preferred level (CGL $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate; E&O $2,000,000; cyber and privacy $5,000,000 where HDI processes our Confidential Information or user data; statutory workers' compensation; certificates on request), placed in the General Provisions and leaving all other text untouched. If HDI resists the limits, the fallback of E&O $1,000,000 and cyber $2,000,000 remains acceptable.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 10.9 (Insurance) requiring HDI to carry commercial general liability, errors and omissions, cyber/privacy and workers' compensation insurance and to provide certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The agreement contains no insurance covenant even though HDI hosts the Site and handles user information, so we have added a standard insurance paragraph: CGL of $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate, E&O of $2,000,000, cyber and privacy of $5,000,000 where HDI processes our Confidential Information or user data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request. If helpful, our fallback is E&O of $1,000,000 and cyber of $2,000,000.

ops.text: Insurance. HDI shall maintain, at its own expense, during the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than $2,000,000; where HDI processes the Company's Confidential Information or user data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than $5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. HDI shall provide the Company with certificates of insurance upon request.

mappings.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
